messages:
emma_sales: Heads up - NorthernTrust procurement emailed asking for an "assurance bundle" for their POC. They want SOC 2 Type II evidence, ISO 27001 snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation (they will not accept raw vuln details). Need this packaged by COB Thursday for their reviewers.

ryan_se: We can do that. Source artifacts: SOC2 summary (redacted), ISO cert scan, ForgeSec attestation stub, pen-test executive summary (redacted). We should include an explicit line about Private deployment/KMS separation since their security team is picky.

priya_compliance: I can assemble a POC packet and produce a one-page attestation they can keep on file. Questions: 1) Do they require the exact engagement dates for the pen-test? 2) Is an internal remediation summary acceptable instead of the full report? Legal will need to sign the attestation. I can have a draft in 12-18 hours if we have the remediation notes.

marco_engineering: For the KMS note, suggest: `Customer-managed keys remain in their VPC; Redwood does not export or hold customer KMS private keys.` Also include a line about logs/retention: `Control-plane and inference logs are retained per customer config; audit logs can be exported on request.` I'll add an SVG of the Private deployment flow.

jake_sales: Pricing ask from procurement: they also want to know if Dedicated trial pricing differs from hosted for the POC. Keep it simple: "Dedicated trial pricing is available for POCs; contact sales for quote and short-term commit options."

priya_compliance: Draft attestation language I'm proposing:
```
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a third-party penetration test covering the Redwood inference control plane and related hosting components was completed by ForgeSec on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is controlled; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance purposes.
Regards,
Redwood Inference - Compliance
```

ryan_se: Procurement clarified by DM: they do NOT need the full ForgeSec report, only the vendor attestation + a concise remediation summary and a drawing showing KMS isolation. That matches our typical POC flow.

compliancebot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-4399 assigned to priya_compliance. Due 1914219999.

priya_compliance: I'll prepare a zipped packet and upload to secure presign location. Expected contents: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert_scan.jpg, 3) Attestation_Forgesec_signed_draft.pdf (pending legal), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_arch_diagram.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) One-line telemetry statement.

marco_engineering: Telemetry suggestion: `Telemetry is used only for aggregated performance metrics; no customer data is used to train models.`

priya_compliance: Good, adding that. Uploading now to internal presign (expires in 7 days). Link: https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4399/northerntrust-poc-bundle.zip?exp=7d (internal only).

emma_sales: I'll send the presigned link to NorthernTrust procurement and confirm whether they need Legal to countersign before download. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

jake_sales: If they push for the full report we will require an NDA and redaction process; legal to handle.

priya_compliance: Draft ready; awaiting legal signature. Will update EVID-4399 when signed and re-upload final ZIP.

emma_sales: Noted, closing the loop for now.
